scripts.build:production: pnpm build:share && pnpm build:protocol && pnpm build:core && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:cli && pnpm build:fe
scripts.test:skills: vitest --run --project share --project core --project api-unit packages/core/src/skills packages/share/src/config/schemas/skills.schema.unit.test.ts backend/src/api/skills backend/src/api/mcp/skills-protocol.integration.test.ts backend/src/services/skills-config.integration.test.ts
scripts.coverage:full: pnpm test:coverage && pnpm coverage:merge && pnpm coverage:report
scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules
scripts.release:dry-run: pnpm --filter "./packages/**" exec rm -rf dist && pnpm build:share && pnpm build:protocol && pnpm build:core && pnpm build:cli && node scripts/check-release-packages.cjs
scripts.release:validate: pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run test:release && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:production && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && node scripts/check-release-packages.cjs
